answer.content: After two consecutive plan reviews confirming no explicit, time-bound decay models are reported in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1, the current inquiry lacks empirical grounding. The research must be bounded to a different, testable question that does not assume the existence of such models without direct evidence from the source text. This ensures all claims are derived solely from explicit, extractable content in the primary source and prevents premature inference or hypothesis generation.
